Exercise 11.4 — Scenario design and validation, numerically
      
      
        (a) For $d=1$ show that the Campi–Garatti bound reduces to $(1-\epsilon)^N\le\beta$; compute $N$ for $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-3}$. (b) A common-Lyapunov LMI with $d_x=2$, $d_u=1$ has $n_k=2d_x^2+d_xd_u$ variables. For $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-5}$ compare the exact scenario sample size (calculator) with the sufficient formula. (c) For validation with $\alpha=0.01$, $\epsilon_{\mathrm{val}}=0.02$, compute $M_{\mathrm{val}}$ with the corrected and the misprinted rule; what confidence does the misprinted size give? (d) With $c=0.95$, $\epsilon=0.05$ and (c), what does the corrected theorem guarantee?
        
          Show answer
          
            (a) Only the term $i=0$ remains: $(1-\epsilon)^N\le\beta\iff N\ge\ln(1/\beta)/(-\ln(1-\epsilon))$. For the given values, $\ln1000/\ln(20/19)\approx134.7$ (with $\ln1000\approx6.9078$ and $\ln(20/19)\approx0.051293$), so $N=135$. Under the convex scenario-program assumptions, at most one sample can support the one-variable solution, and a violation above $\epsilon$ needs all $N$ samples to miss an $\epsilon$-mass region.
            (b) $n_k=10$. The binomial tail first drops below $10^{-5}$ at $N=581$ ($9.67\cdot10^{-6}$; at $580$ it is $1.003\cdot10^{-5}$); the sufficient formula gives $\lceil40(\ln10^5+10)\rceil=861$, about 48% more.
            (c) Corrected: $\ln100/(2\cdot0.02^2)\approx5756.5$, so $5757$. Misprinted: $\ln100/(2\cdot0.02)\approx115.1$, so $116$, for which $e^{-2\cdot116\cdot0.02^2}=e^{-0.0928}\approx0.911$. Hoeffding supplies the lower confidence bound $1-e^{-0.0928}\approx9\%$, rather than $99\%$ (a lower bound from this inequality, not the actual confidence of the procedure).
            (d) For a fixed $K^\ast$ and one fresh independent batch of at least $5757$ validation samples from the normalized $c=0.95$ credible posterior, with probability at least $0.99$ over that batch, acceptance (empirical stability at least $0.95$) implies that the full posterior probability that $K^\ast$ stabilises the true linearisation is at least $0.95-0.05-0.02=0.88$: a Bayesian statement, as good as the GP posterior. This is a fixed-batch implication; repeated validation attempts need a separate failure budget.

def binomialMass (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (n.choose i : ℝ) * p ^ i * (1 - p) ^ (n - i)

def lowerTail (n d : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, binomialMass n i p

private theorem mass_successor (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    binomialMass (n+1) (i+1) p =
      (1-p)*binomialMass n (i+1) p + p*binomialMass n i p := by
  have he : n-i = (n-(i+1))+1 := by omega
  have he' : n+1-(i+1) = n-i := by omega
  simp only [binomialMass, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.cast_add, he', he, pow_succ]
  ring

private theorem tail_successor_split (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      (1-p)*lowerTail n (m+1) p + p*lowerTail n m p := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [lowerTail, binomialMass, pow_succ]; ring
  | succ m ih =>
    have hmn : m ≤ n := by omega
    have hs := mass_successor n m p (by omega)
    simp only [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ] at ih ⊢
    have hh := ih hmn
    rw [hs]
    linarith

theorem actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      lowerTail n (m+1) p - p*binomialMass n m p := by
  rw [tail_successor_split n m p hm]
  have he : lowerTail n (m+1) p = lowerTail n m p + binomialMass n m p := by
    simp [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_binomial_tail_nonincrease (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hm : m ≤ n) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p ≤ lowerTail n (m+1) p := by
  rw [actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity n m p hm]
  have hn : 0 ≤ p*binomialMass n m p := by
    unfold binomialMass
    positivity
  linarith

theorem actual_ten_term_tail_antitone_from_nine :

    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) using 1

theorem actual_dimension_one_reduction (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ) :

theorem actual_independent_count_lower_tail_probability
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n d : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ i,MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hind : iIndepSet A P) (p : ℝ) (hp : ∀ i,P.real (A i)=p) :
    P.real {w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w < d}=lowerTail n d p := by
  classical
  have he : {w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w < d}=
      ⋃ i∈Finset.range d,{w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w=i} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Set.mem_iUnion,Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · intro h;exact ⟨_,h,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,hi,he⟩;omega
  have hd : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (Finset.range d : Set ℕ)
      (fun i=>{w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w=i}) := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro w hwi hwj
    exact hij (hwi.symm.trans hwj)
  rw [he,measureReal_biUnion_finset hd
    (fun i _ => (measurableSet_singleton i).preimage
      (CompleteAppliedBinomialModel.failure_count_measurable A hA))]
  unfold lowerTail
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact CompleteAppliedBinomialModel.actual_binomial_count_mass P n A hA hind p hp i

    (1/1000:ℝ)<(19/20)^134 ∧ (19/20:ℝ)^135<1/1000 ∧
      |Real.log 1000/Real.log (20/19)-1347/10|<1/20 := by

    CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons.actual_discount_log_enclosure_and_log_hundred_enclosure
  obtain ⟨_,_,h100l,h100u⟩ :=
    CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons.actual_discount_log_enclosure_and_log_hundred_enclosure
  have he1000 : Real.log 1000=(3/2:ℝ)*Real.log 100 := by
    have he : Real.log 1000=3*Real.log 10 := by
      rw [show (1000:ℝ)=(10:ℝ)^3 by norm_num,Real.log_pow]; norm_num
    have he' : Real.log 100=2*Real.log 10 := by
      rw [show (100:ℝ)=(10:ℝ)^2 by norm_num,Real.log_pow]; norm_num
    linarith
  have h1000l : (6907754/1000000:ℝ)<Real.log 1000 := by rw [he1000]; linarith
  have h1000u : Real.log 1000<(6907756/1000000:ℝ) := by rw [he1000]; linarith
  have hd : 0<Real.log (20/19:ℝ) := by linarith

  constructor

      (show (1347/10-1/20)*Real.log (20/19)<Real.log 1000 by linarith)
    linarith

    linarith

    have hn' : n ≤ 580 := by omega

            one_mul,Nat.sub_zero]

        (by norm_num : (19/20:ℝ)≤1) hn9
      have hnum : (1/100000:ℝ)<(19/20)^9 := by norm_num

    have hh := hm (show 572 ≤ n-9 by omega)

private theorem bounded_average_upper_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (m epsilon : ℝ)
    (he : 0≤epsilon) (hInd : iIndepFun X P)
    (hm : ∀ i,AEMeasurable (X i) P)
    (hb : ∀ i,∀ᵐ w ∂P,X i w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i,∫ w,X i w ∂P = m) :
    P.real {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}≤Real.exp (-2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2) := by
  let Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i w=>X i w-m
  have hi : iIndepFun Y P := hInd.comp (fun (_:Fin n) (x:ℝ)=>x-m)
    (fun _=>measurable_id.sub_const m)
  have hsg : ∀i,HasSubgaussianMGF (Y i) (1/4) P := by
    intro i
    have h := CompleteAppliedConcentration.centered_unit_interval_subgaussian P (X i) (hm i) (hb i)
    simpa only [hmean i] using h
  have hs : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun w=>∑i,Y i w) ((n:ℝ≥0)/4) P := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hi
      (s:=Finset.univ) (c:=fun _=>(1/4:ℝ≥0)) (fun i _=>hsg i)
  have hnreal : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have ht := hs.measure_ge_le (mul_nonneg hnreal.le he)
  have hset : {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}=
      {w | (n:ℝ)*epsilon≤∑i,Y i w} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have heq : empirical n X w-m=(1/(n:ℝ))*∑i,Y i w := by
      simp only [empirical,Y,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [heq,one_div_mul_eq_div,le_div_iff₀ hnreal,mul_comm epsilon (n:ℝ)]
  have hexp : -((n:ℝ)*epsilon)^2/(2*((((n:ℝ≥0)/4):ℝ≥0):ℝ))=
      -2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2 := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp] at ht
  rw [hset]
  exact ht

def sampleMaximum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty s

def sampledFeasible {ι : Type*} (s : ι → ℝ) : Set ℝ := {x | ∀ i, s i ≤ x}

/-- Removing this constraint genuinely permits a smaller objective value. -/
def supporting {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : ℝ, (∀ j, j ≠ i → s j ≤ x) ∧ x < sampleMaximum s

theorem actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_the_sample_maximum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) :
    IsLeast (sampledFeasible s) (sampleMaximum s) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact Finset.le_sup' s (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · intro x hx
    exact (Finset.sup'_le_iff Finset.univ_nonempty s).mpr (fun i _ => hx i)

theorem actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_unique
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : IsLeast (sampledFeasible s) x) : x = sampleMaximum s :=
  hx.unique (actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_the_sample_maximum s)

theorem actual_sample_maximum_is_attained_by_a_sample
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) :
    ∃ i, sampleMaximum s = s i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty s
  exact ⟨i, hi⟩

theorem actual_support_constraint_is_a_strict_unique_maximum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (hi : supporting s i) : sampleMaximum s = s i ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j < s i := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxm⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := actual_sample_maximum_is_attained_by_a_sample s
  have hki : k = i := by
    by_contra h
    have hle := hx k h
    rw [← hk] at hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt hxm) hle
  have he : sampleMaximum s = s i := hki ▸ hk
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hl := hx j hj
  rw [he] at hxm
  exact hl.trans_lt hxm

theorem actual_strict_unique_maximum_is_a_support_constraint
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (hi : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j < s i) : supporting s i := by
  classical
  have hm : sampleMaximum s = s i := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (Finset.sup'_le_iff Finset.univ_nonempty s).mpr (fun j _ => by
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · exact hji ▸ le_rfl
        · exact (hi j hji).le)
    · exact (actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_the_sample_maximum s).1 i
  by_cases he : (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset ι).Nonempty
  · refine ⟨(Finset.univ.erase i).sup' he s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      exact Finset.le_sup' s (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)
    · rw [hm]
      exact (Finset.sup'_lt_iff he).mpr (fun j hj => hi j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
  · refine ⟨s i - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      exact False.elim (he ⟨j, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ j⟩⟩)
    · rw [hm]
      linarith

theorem actual_at_most_one_sample_constraint_is_supporting
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) :
    Set.Subsingleton {i | supporting s i} := by
  intro i hi j hj
  by_contra hij
  have hji := (actual_support_constraint_is_a_strict_unique_maximum s i hi).2 j (Ne.symm hij)
  have hij' := (actual_support_constraint_is_a_strict_unique_maximum s j hj).2 i hij
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hij'.le) hji

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ)

  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr

def feasible {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  {x | x ∈ domain ∧ ∀ i, x ∈ constraints i}

/-- Removing one actual sampled constraint permits a strictly smaller scalar objective. -/
def supportsAt {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ)
    (optimum : ℝ) (i : ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : ℝ, x ∈ domain ∧ (∀ j, j ≠ i → x ∈ constraints j) ∧ x < optimum

theorem actual_two_distinct_convex_scalar_constraints_cannot_both_support
    {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ) (optimum : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (constraints i))
    (hopt : IsLeast (feasible domain constraints) optimum)
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hi : supportsAt domain constraints optimum i)
    (hj : supportsAt domain constraints optimum j) : False := by
  obtain ⟨x, hxd, hx, hxo⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨y, hyd, hy, hyo⟩ := hj
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hyx
  · have hcy : y ∈ constraints j :=
      (hc j).ordConnected.out (hx j (Ne.symm hij)) (hopt.1.2 j) ⟨hxy, hyo.le⟩
    have hf : y ∈ feasible domain constraints := by
      refine ⟨hyd, ?_⟩
      intro k
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · exact hkj ▸ hcy
      · exact hy k hkj
    exact (not_le_of_gt hyo) (hopt.2 hf)
  · have hcx : x ∈ constraints i :=
      (hc i).ordConnected.out (hy i hij) (hopt.1.2 i) ⟨hyx, hxo.le⟩
    have hf : x ∈ feasible domain constraints := by
      refine ⟨hxd, ?_⟩
      intro k
      by_cases hki : k = i

def binomialMass (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (n.choose i : ℝ) * p ^ i * (1 - p) ^ (n - i)

def lowerTail (n d : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, binomialMass n i p

private theorem mass_successor (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    binomialMass (n+1) (i+1) p =
      (1-p)*binomialMass n (i+1) p + p*binomialMass n i p := by
  have he : n-i = (n-(i+1))+1 := by omega
  have he' : n+1-(i+1) = n-i := by omega
  simp only [binomialMass, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.cast_add, he', he, pow_succ]
  ring

private theorem tail_successor_split (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      (1-p)*lowerTail n (m+1) p + p*lowerTail n m p := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [lowerTail, binomialMass, pow_succ]; ring
  | succ m ih =>
    have hmn : m ≤ n := by omega
    have hs := mass_successor n m p (by omega)
    simp only [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ] at ih ⊢
    have hh := ih hmn
    rw [hs]
    linarith

theorem actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      lowerTail n (m+1) p - p*binomialMass n m p := by
  rw [tail_successor_split n m p hm]
  have he : lowerTail n (m+1) p = lowerTail n m p + binomialMass n m p := by
    simp [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_binomial_tail_nonincrease (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hm : m ≤ n) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p ≤ lowerTail n (m+1) p := by
  rw [actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity n m p hm]
  have hn : 0 ≤ p*binomialMass n m p := by
    unfold binomialMass
    positivity
  linarith

    Antitone (fun k : ℕ => lowerTail (k+9) 10 (1/20)) := by

private theorem bounded_average_upper_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (m epsilon : ℝ)
    (he : 0≤epsilon) (hInd : iIndepFun X P)
    (hm : ∀ i,AEMeasurable (X i) P)
    (hb : ∀ i,∀ᵐ w ∂P,X i w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i,∫ w,X i w ∂P = m) :
    P.real {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}≤Real.exp (-2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2) := by
  let Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i w=>X i w-m
  have hi : iIndepFun Y P := hInd.comp (fun (_:Fin n) (x:ℝ)=>x-m)
    (fun _=>measurable_id.sub_const m)
  have hsg : ∀i,HasSubgaussianMGF (Y i) (1/4) P := by
    intro i
    have h := CompleteAppliedConcentration.centered_unit_interval_subgaussian P (X i) (hm i) (hb i)
    simpa only [hmean i] using h
  have hs : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun w=>∑i,Y i w) ((n:ℝ≥0)/4) P := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hi
      (s:=Finset.univ) (c:=fun _=>(1/4:ℝ≥0)) (fun i _=>hsg i)
  have hnreal : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have ht := hs.measure_ge_le (mul_nonneg hnreal.le he)
  have hset : {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}=
      {w | (n:ℝ)*epsilon≤∑i,Y i w} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have heq : empirical n X w-m=(1/(n:ℝ))*∑i,Y i w := by
      simp only [empirical,Y,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [heq,one_div_mul_eq_div,le_div_iff₀ hnreal,mul_comm epsilon (n:ℝ)]
  have hexp : -((n:ℝ)*epsilon)^2/(2*((((n:ℝ≥0)/4):ℝ≥0):ℝ))=
      -2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2 := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp] at ht
  rw [hset]
  exact ht

def binomialMass (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (n.choose i : ℝ) * p ^ i * (1 - p) ^ (n - i)

def lowerTail (n d : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, binomialMass n i p

private theorem mass_successor (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    binomialMass (n+1) (i+1) p =
      (1-p)*binomialMass n (i+1) p + p*binomialMass n i p := by
  have he : n-i = (n-(i+1))+1 := by omega
  have he' : n+1-(i+1) = n-i := by omega
  simp only [binomialMass, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.cast_add, he', he, pow_succ]
  ring

private theorem tail_successor_split (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      (1-p)*lowerTail n (m+1) p + p*lowerTail n m p := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [lowerTail, binomialMass, pow_succ]; ring
  | succ m ih =>
    have hmn : m ≤ n := by omega
    have hs := mass_successor n m p (by omega)
    simp only [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ] at ih ⊢
    have hh := ih hmn
    rw [hs]
    linarith

theorem actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      lowerTail n (m+1) p - p*binomialMass n m p := by
  rw [tail_successor_split n m p hm]
  have he : lowerTail n (m+1) p = lowerTail n m p + binomialMass n m p := by
    simp [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  rw [he]
  ring

private theorem bounded_average_upper_tail

    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (m epsilon : ℝ)
    (he : 0≤epsilon) (hInd : iIndepFun X P)
    (hm : ∀ i,AEMeasurable (X i) P)
    (hb : ∀ i,∀ᵐ w ∂P,X i w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i,∫ w,X i w ∂P = m) :
    P.real {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}≤Real.exp (-2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2) := by
  let Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i w=>X i w-m
  have hi : iIndepFun Y P := hInd.comp (fun (_:Fin n) (x:ℝ)=>x-m)
    (fun _=>measurable_id.sub_const m)
  have hsg : ∀i,HasSubgaussianMGF (Y i) (1/4) P := by
    intro i
    have h := CompleteAppliedConcentration.centered_unit_interval_subgaussian P (X i) (hm i) (hb i)
    simpa only [hmean i] using h
  have hs : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun w=>∑i,Y i w) ((n:ℝ≥0)/4) P := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hi
      (s:=Finset.univ) (c:=fun _=>(1/4:ℝ≥0)) (fun i _=>hsg i)
  have hnreal : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have ht := hs.measure_ge_le (mul_nonneg hnreal.le he)
  have hset : {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}=
      {w | (n:ℝ)*epsilon≤∑i,Y i w} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have heq : empirical n X w-m=(1/(n:ℝ))*∑i,Y i w := by
      simp only [empirical,Y,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [heq,one_div_mul_eq_div,le_div_iff₀ hnreal,mul_comm epsilon (n:ℝ)]
  have hexp : -((n:ℝ)*epsilon)^2/(2*((((n:ℝ≥0)/4):ℝ≥0):ℝ))=
      -2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2 := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp] at ht
  rw [hset]
  exact ht

def feasible {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ) : Set ℝ :=

def supportsAt {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ)
    (optimum : ℝ) (i : ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : ℝ, x ∈ domain ∧ (∀ j, j ≠ i → x ∈ constraints j) ∧ x < optimum

theorem actual_two_distinct_convex_scalar_constraints_cannot_both_support
    {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ) (optimum : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (constraints i))
    (hopt : IsLeast (feasible domain constraints) optimum)
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hi : supportsAt domain constraints optimum i)
    (hj : supportsAt domain constraints optimum j) : False := by
  obtain ⟨x, hxd, hx, hxo⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨y, hyd, hy, hyo⟩ := hj
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hyx
  · have hcy : y ∈ constraints j :=
      (hc j).ordConnected.out (hx j (Ne.symm hij)) (hopt.1.2 j) ⟨hxy, hyo.le⟩
    have hf : y ∈ feasible domain constraints := by
      refine ⟨hyd, ?_⟩
      intro k
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · exact hkj ▸ hcy
      · exact hy k hkj
    exact (not_le_of_gt hyo) (hopt.2 hf)
  · have hcx : x ∈ constraints i :=
      (hc i).ordConnected.out (hy i hij) (hopt.1.2 i) ⟨hyx, hxo.le⟩
    have hf : x ∈ feasible domain constraints := by
      refine ⟨hxd, ?_⟩
      intro k
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · exact hki ▸ hcx
      · exact hx k hki
    exact (not_le_of_gt hxo) (hopt.2 hf)

    {ι : Type*} (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ) (optimum : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (constraints i))
    (hopt : IsLeast (feasible domain constraints) optimum) :
    Set.Subsingleton {i | supportsAt domain constraints optimum i} := by
  intro i hi j hj
  by_contra hij
  exact actual_two_distinct_convex_scalar_constraints_cannot_both_support
    domain constraints optimum hc hopt i j hij hi hj

theorem actual_finite_convex_scalar_support_count_is_at_most_one
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (domain : Set ℝ) (constraints : ι → Set ℝ)
    (optimum : ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, Convex ℝ (constraints i))
    (hopt : IsLeast (feasible domain constraints) optimum)
    [DecidablePred (supportsAt domain constraints optimum)] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (supportsAt domain constraints optimum)).card ≤ 1 := by
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro i hi j hj
  exact actual_general_convex_scalar_support_set_has_at_most_one_element
    domain constraints optimum hc hopt (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2

  have he : n-i = (n-(i+1))+1 := by omega

def sampleMaximum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=

def supporting {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : Prop :=

theorem actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_the_sample_maximum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) :
    IsLeast (sampledFeasible s) (sampleMaximum s) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact Finset.le_sup' s (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · intro x hx
    exact (Finset.sup'_le_iff Finset.univ_nonempty s).mpr (fun i _ => hx i)

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (x : ℝ)

  hx.unique (actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_the_sample_maximum s)

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) :
    ∃ i, sampleMaximum s = s i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty s
  exact ⟨i, hi⟩

theorem actual_support_constraint_is_a_strict_unique_maximum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι)

  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxm⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := actual_sample_maximum_is_attained_by_a_sample s
  have hki : k = i := by
    by_contra h
    have hle := hx k h
    rw [← hk] at hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt hxm) hle
  have he : sampleMaximum s = s i := hki ▸ hk
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hl := hx j hj
  rw [he] at hxm
  exact hl.trans_lt hxm

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (hi : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j < s i) : supporting s i := by
  classical
  have hm : sampleMaximum s = s i := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (Finset.sup'_le_iff Finset.univ_nonempty s).mpr (fun j _ => by
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · exact hji ▸ le_rfl
        · exact (hi j hji).le)
    · exact (actual_scalar_scenario_optimizer_is_the_sample_maximum s).1 i
  by_cases he : (Finset.univ.erase i : Finset ι).Nonempty
  · refine ⟨(Finset.univ.erase i).sup' he s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      exact Finset.le_sup' s (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)
    · rw [hm]
      exact (Finset.sup'_lt_iff he).mpr (fun j hj => hi j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
  · refine ⟨s i - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      exact False.elim (he ⟨j, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ j⟩⟩)
    · rw [hm]
      linarith

For $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-5}$ compare the exact scenario sample size (calculator) with the sufficient formula. (c) For validation with $\alpha=0.01$, $\epsilon_{\mathrm{val}}=0.02$, compute $M_{\mathrm{val}}$ with the corrected and the misprinted rule; what confidence does the misprinted size give? Exercise 11.4 — Scenario design and validation, numerically
      
      
        (a) For $d=1$ show that the Campi–Garatti bound reduces to $(1-\epsilon)^N\le\beta$; compute $N$ for $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-3}$. (b) A common-Lyapunov LMI with $d_x=2$, $d_u=1$ has $n_k=2d_x^2+d_xd_u$ variables. For $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-5}$ compare the exact scenario sample size (calculator) with the sufficient formula. (c) For validation with $\alpha=0.01$, $\epsilon_{\mathrm{val}}=0.02$, compute $M_{\mathrm{val}}$ with the corrected and the misprinted rule; what confidence does the misprinted size give? (d) With $c=0.95$, $\epsilon=0.05$ and (c), what does the corrected theorem guarantee?
        
          Show answer
          
            (a) Only the term $i=0$ remains: $(1-\epsilon)^N\le\beta\iff N\ge\ln(1/\beta)/(-\ln(1-\epsilon))=6.9078/0.051293=134.7$, so $N=135$. With one variable only one sample can support the solution, and a violation above $\epsilon$ needs all $N$ samples to miss an $\epsilon$-mass region.

Misprinted: $\ln100/(2\cdot0.02)=115.1$, so $116$, for which $e^{-2\cdot116\cdot0.02^2}=e^{-0.0928}=0.911$: so Hoeffding certifies a confidence of only $1-0.911\approx9\%$, not $99\%$ (a lower bound from this inequality, not the actual confidence of the procedure).
